Yogurt:
Ingredients:
- 2 cups vanilla yogurt, or plain Greek yogurt
- 1 cup granola
- 1 cup berries, such as blackberries, blueberries, or strawberries
- honey, optional
Instructions:
- In a glass, layer yogurt, fruit, and granola.
- Repeat the layers.
- Drizzle with honey if you want it sweeter.
- Eat it soon so the granola stays crunchy.
Banana Pudding:
Ingredients:
- 1 can sweetened condensed milk
- 1 1/2 cups cold water
- 1 box instant vanilla pudding
- 3 cups heavy cream, whipped
- 1 box vanilla wafers
- 5 ripe bananas, sliced
Instructions:
- Beat the condensed milk, water, and pudding mix. Chill until it sets, then fold in the whipped cream.
- Layer pudding, wafers, and bananas in a large bowl. Keep the banana slices covered with pudding so they do not brown.
- Chill at least 4 hours before serving.
Buffalo Chicken Dip:
Ingredients:
- 2 cans chunk chicken, drained, or about 3 cups shredded cooked chicken
- 2 packages cream cheese, softened
- 3/4 cup hot sauce
- 1 cup ranch dressing
- 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar
Instructions:
- Warm the chicken with the hot sauce.
- Stir in the cream cheese and ranch until smooth.
- Mix in half the cheddar and top with the rest.
- Heat until bubbly. Serve with celery and crackers.
Caprese:
Ingredients:
- 4 ripe tomatoes, sliced
- 1 pound fresh mozzarella, sliced
- fresh basil leaves
- olive oil, salt, and pepper
Instructions:
- Overlap the tomato, mozzarella, and basil on a platter.
- Drizzle with olive oil.
- Season with salt and pepper and serve right away.
Chipotle Mayonnaise:
Ingredients:
- 1 cup mayonnaise
- 1 canned chipotle pepper in adobo
- 2 teaspoons adobo sauce from the can
- 1 teaspoon lime juice
- salt
Instructions:
- Blend until smooth.
- Keep it in the fridge for up to a week.
Energy Bites:
Ingredients:
- 1 cup rolled oats
- 1/2 cup chocolate chips
- 1/2 cup ground flaxseed
- 1/2 cup peanut butter
- 1/3 cup honey
- 1 teaspoon vanilla
Instructions:
- Stir everything together.
- Roll into balls.
- Freeze until firm, about 1 hour.
Garbanzo Beans:
Ingredients:
- 1 pound dried chickpeas
- salt
- bay leaf, garlic, and onion, optional
Instructions:
- Pick through the beans, rinse them, and soak in plenty of water for at least 8 hours. Drain and rinse.
- Cover with fresh water. Add salt and the aromatics if you are using them.
- Simmer until tender, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Japanese Curry:
Ingredients:
- chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
- onion, carrot, and potato
- about 4 cups chicken broth
- 1 box Japanese curry roux
- 1 tablespoon each soy sauce, ketchup, and honey
- rice, for serving
Instructions:
- Brown the chicken, then cook the vegetables in the broth until the potatoes are tender.
- Stir in the soy sauce, ketchup, and honey.
- Turn off the heat. Dissolve the curry roux in a ladle of the hot liquid, then stir it back into the pot. Repeat until the sauce is thick.
- Simmer a few minutes and serve over rice.
Mexican Rice:
Ingredients:
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 1/2 large onion, chopped
- 2 cups long-grain rice
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles
- 1 can whole tomatoes
- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- salt
Instructions:
- Cook the onion in the oil. Add the rice and garlic and toast the rice for a few minutes.
- Stir in the tomatoes, broth, cumin, and salt.
- Cover and simmer until the rice is tender, about 10 to 15 minutes. Add a splash more broth if it dries out.
Pickles:
Ingredients:
- about 2 pounds Kirby cucumbers, cut into spears
- 1 1/4 cups distilled white vinegar
- 3 tablespoons kosher salt
- 2 tablespoons sugar
- 2 cups cold water
- garlic cloves, fresh dill, mustard seed, and coriander seed
Instructions:
- Heat the vinegar with the salt and sugar until they dissolve. Stir in the cold water and chill the brine.
- Pack the cucumbers, garlic, dill, and seeds into jars.
- Cover with brine and refrigerate about 24 hours. They keep in the fridge for about a month.
Pizza:
Ingredients:
- 2 teaspoons yeast
- about 1 cup lukewarm water
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/4 teaspoons salt
Instructions:
- Mix and knead into a soft, smooth dough.
- Let it rise until puffy, about 1 hour with instant yeast.
- Shape it, add sauce and toppings, and bake on a hot oven, about 450°F.
Sloppy Joes:
Ingredients:
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 cup finely chopped onion
- 1/2 cup minced carrot or bell pepper
- 1 1/4 pounds ground beef
- 1/2 cup ketchup
- 2 cups tomato sauce
- 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
- 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
- 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar
- hamburger buns
Instructions:
- Cook the vegetables, then brown the beef. Drain off extra fat.
- Stir in the ketchup, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, vinegar, and brown sugar.
- Simmer about 10 minutes. Spoon onto buns.
